subject: ddl: introduce `newDefaultReorgDistSQLCtx` to replace mock context in DDL reorg (#53467)
summary: Reviewed the first-parent diff in `pkg/ddl` around the DDL reorg desc-scan path (`ddlCtx.buildDescTableScan` / `GetTableMaxHandle`). The change replaces `mock.NewContext()` usage with `newDefaultReorgDistSQLCtx(dc.store.GetClient())`, while still providing the non-nil DistSQL fields that `distsql.Select`/`selectResult.fetchResp` rely on (Client/KVVars/WarnHandler/ErrCtx/SQLKiller/ExecDetails/Location) and keeping handle-range encoding behavior (common-handle path uses DistSQLContext.Location/ErrCtx). Added unit test asserts compatibility with the prior mock-derived DistSQLContext. Later history up to `upstream/master` shows further refactoring toward static reorg contexts (e.g. #55823) but no follow-up bugfix indicating a correctness regression from this commit.
